_about: US Department of Transportation, Airline Cancellation and Delay Dashboard. Transcribed by lane 1 (TF4) in a real browser. Master copy: sites/downtimecredit/flights/flights.js (FLIGHTS.AIRLINES), text of the page in research/TF4-dot-dashboard-source.md. Lane 1 owns updates; do not edit this file.
how_to_say_it: The dashboard shows what each airline has COMMITTED to in its own customer service plan. Say 'has committed to', never 'must cover'. It covers cancellations and delays the AIRLINE CAUSES (the page's examples: maintenance, crew problems, cabin cleaning, baggage loading, fueling). It does NOT say what an airline gives for weather or air traffic control; the one airline text lane 1 read on that, Frontier's plan, says it gives re-accommodation and a refund of the unused ticket but no other compensation for uncontrollable causes such as weather or Air Traffic Control. The refund duty under 14 CFR 260.6 is separate and applies whatever the cause. 'No' means no commitment; the page says an airline may still help at its discretion.
airline_plan_links_are_unread: Lane 1 opened and read only Frontier's and JetBlue's own plan pages (and part of American's). The other links are as the dashboard lists them.

commitment_labels.rebook_same: Rebook on the same airline at no additional cost
commitment_labels.rebook_other: Rebook on a partner airline, or another airline it has an agreement with, at no additional cost
commitment_labels.meal: Meal or meal cash/voucher when the delay or cancellation means a wait of 3 hours or more
commitment_labels.hotel: Complimentary hotel for any passenger affected by an overnight cancellation or delay
commitment_labels.transport: Complimentary ground transportation to and from the hotel for an overnight cancellation or delay
commitment_labels.cash: Cash compensation when the wait is 3 hours or more from the scheduled departure
commitment_labels.voucher: Credit or travel voucher when the wait is 3 hours or more from the scheduled departure
commitment_labels.miles: Frequent flyer miles when the wait is 3 hours or more from the scheduled departure
